STATISTICAL ANALYSIS
  Independent runs (fresh server/output per run; no shared seed): unpaired design, n=10 per cell.
  Reported: mean, median, standard deviation, and a descriptive 95% t CI of the mean (df=9, t=2.262).
  No significance tests: the design has no pairing and the task forbids ranking/superiority claims.

CAVEATS
  - Chunk-size performance tradeoff is not strongly modeled by the harness (server paces each
    request at a fixed rate), so chunk-size adaptation cannot be validated from throughput.
  - Credit assignment is approximate under concurrency>1 (one serialized decision per completion).
  - Reward weights were not tuned; LinUCB alpha (0.2) was not tuned.
  - LinUCB selected ActionNone in every run (no exploration); no overlapping LinUCB samples exist.
  - loss scenario shows high wall-clock variance (TCP retransmits).
  - Fairness not implemented. No aria2/IDM comparison.
